comments: c32a5e70: This program generates various reports for deferred documents, such as OP Reports, Discharge Summaries, and Interim Summaries.
4e918839: If multiple divisions are enabled, prompt the user to select divisions.
ba5b32bb: If not using multiple divisions, automatically select the first division.
eb23d0bd: Execute the selected report type.
63631bf7: Prompt for date range for the report.
6ab1d8e7: Filter for specific summary types (OP Report, Interim Summary, Discharge Summary).
e5c5ac91: Allow the user to select one or more summary types for the report.
fc928805: Notify the user that the report is formatted for 132 column output.
e191144e: Set up the report date to be used in the header of the report.
d716fabb: Initialize variables and start the report generation process.
e3024709: Exit the program.
4cb56e0b: Initialize variables for report calculation.
9d5145a1: If generating a list or detailed report, proceed with the report generation.
b703b32d: If generating a statistical report, proceed with the statistical report generation.
961bb1f8: Display a message if no records match the criteria.
a66c7603: Exit the procedure and return to the calling routine.
9cb4e7c0: Calculate the percentage of documents completed within certain time frames.

adda6316: If the report is by physician, update the physician's total and their count of documents completed within 30 days.
56bfadf4: Additional processing for physician-specific summaries.
f5430412: For service reports, update service totals and counts of documents completed within 30 days.

a030d84d: End of a procedure or function.

d16bf1d0: Exclude records not marked as 'Signed'.
b5c89b56: Exclude signed records if the report is configured to do so.
4c9c9f30: Exclude discharge summaries without a corresponding admission or discharge movement.
167f0529: Determine the reporting category based on the report type.
b35987f5: Exclude records not of the specified summary types.
042d8adc: Exclude physicians not selected by the user.
f9a8bf2b: Exclude services not selected by the user.
14b06133: Exclude summary types not selected by the user.
c84af552: Exclude records outside the specified date range.
584b1336: Load detailed information for the document.
b67bc0eb: Set the division name for later use in the report.
0e4d80b9: Adjust the division name length for service reports.
c193154f: Retrieve the patient's name for the report.
8e7acced: Process entries for reports by physician.
750e71ee: Set up service and specialty names for the report.
62d51f96: Finalize processing of service-specific entries.
0ba7fb44: End of the check routine.

bda7c2ac: Update physician-specific performance totals.
af28571e: Update service-specific performance totals.

bea1dd8d: End of physician selection routine.
61d9a2ca: Start service selection.

55a3b839: End of service/specialty selection routine.
